SELECT s.region, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_amt, sum(r.standard_cost_returned) cost_ret, sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date < f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale, sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date < DATE '2025-01-27' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) from_earlier_sale,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(r.refund_net - f.net_amount*r.quantity_returned/f.quantity) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) refund_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.product_key <> f.product_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prod_diff
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (SELECT st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) all_net, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) nonstaff_net
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND st.store_id IN (101,106,108,999,900) GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_before, sum(returns_net) rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) rpt_net, sum(receipts) rc, sum(units_sold) u
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT * FROM s FULL JOIN r USING (store_id) ORDER BY 1

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT p.sku, s.store_id, s.region, f.staff_purchase_flag AS staff, f.net_amount - f.standard_cost AS margin
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.store_id < 900
), rets AS (
  SELECT p.sku, s.store_id, s.region, fs.staff_purchase_flag AS staff, -(r.refund_net - r.standard_cost_returned) AS margin
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  JOIN fact_sales_line fs ON fs.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.store_id < 900
), u AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets),
agg AS (
  SELECT sku,
   sum(CASE WHEN region='South' THEN margin END) m_main,
   sum(CASE WHEN region='South' AND NOT staff THEN margin END) m_nostaff,
   sum(CASE WHEN region='South' THEN margin END) - 0 AS m_chk
  FROM u GROUP BY sku
)
SELECT a.sku, (SELECT max(product_name) FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku=a.sku) nm, (SELECT max(category) FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku=a.sku) cat, round(m_main,2) m_main, round(m_nostaff,2) m_nostaff,
 rank() OVER (ORDER BY m_main DESC) rk_main, rank() OVER (ORDER BY m_nostaff DESC) rk_nostaff
FROM agg a WHERE m_main IS NOT NULL QUALIFY rk_main<=14 OR rk_nostaff<=12 ORDER BY rk_main

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT p.sku, f.net_amount - f.standard_cost AS margin
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
    AND s.region = 'South' AND s.store_id < 900
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.sku, -(r.refund_net - r.standard_cost_returned)
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
    AND s.region = 'South' AND s.store_id < 900
)
SELECT 'FY2024/25' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_quarter, l.sku,
  (SELECT max(product_name) FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku = l.sku) AS product_name,
  round(sum(l.margin), 2) AS gross_margin_eur
FROM lines l GROUP BY l.sku ORDER BY gross_margin_eur DESC LIMIT 10
